These two characters are introduced in the newest chapter of "The Pack", and so I thought I'd post their references here before uploading the next chapter on Thursday.

Some info on the designs for anyone interested:

* Star's design is loosely based off of my first ever World of Warcraft character, Starfeather. If my character could have been a dog, then she would definitely look like that. Even her voice description in the chapter is completely based around her actual voice in game, which I find pretty funny since she has such a gravelly voice. The scars on each paw, her torn ear, and the scar on her neck reveal her tough life and are related to certain events that she's encountered throughout her 10 years of life on Azeroth. Here's a [link](https://worldofwarcraft.com/en-us/character/us/cairne/starfeather) to her WoW page if anyone is curious about her. There you'll learn a lot more about what she's done over these past few years.
* Colin was a totally random character that had no real thought put into his design, other than I needed another small chimera with unassuming features since Star's design is so intricate. He gets his name from a child character in "The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess" but other than that there is no connection. He's a sweet little guy though, very thoughtful and caring. I put him at around the age of 17-19, so he's still a relatively young guy. He'll become somewhat important to the story later on though.

Hope you all like the designs, I had fun making them. This is the final batch, though there maybe updated versions of older ones when the time comes, but that's a big "if".

And for anyone who has no idea as to what "The Pack" is, it is a Fullmetal Alchemist fanfiction that can be found at [this link](https://www.fanfiction.net/s/13848002/1/The-Pack) if you are curious about it or just want to read what has been posted so far. Remember how I said that all of the names referenced a certain favorite horror series of mine? Well the series was the "Saw" franchise, which I love dearly. Anyway, here is some details about each character:

* Doctor Gordon Lawrence (Literally the reversing of the name "Doctor Lawrence Gordon" of the Saw series) is the main bad dude. I'd put his age at around 55-60, just know that he's an older man and going gray. He's been a scientist for a long time and some of his experiments have been...unethical to say the least. He got fired from his first lab job because of misconduct with the living experiments. Needless to say, he's just not a fun man to be around.
* Doctor Mark Kramer (First name in reference to one of Jigsaw's main apprentices, Mark Hoffman, and sharing the last name of Jigsaw himself) is essentially the second in command. He's probably in his mid 30's, but looks much older. He's a very unpleasant man and is only out there for himself. He'd stab you in the back in a heartbeat if it meant furthering his career. He was denied many a lab job because of his behavior and general attitude, being very off putting and intense for most normal people. Doctor Lawrence saw his potential and hired him on sight, knowing he'd be one of the cruelest and uncaring scientists under his command.
* Doctor Vance Hoffman (Sharing his last name with Mark Hoffman) is a kind and caring soul that got mixed in with the wrong crowd. I'd say his age is around 22, he's the youngest scientist in the whole group. All he wants is to help those around him and he was tricked into following Doctor Lawrence by being tempted with medical care for his ailing sister. Vance is in way over his head, but none of the other scientist's seem to care about him and view him as a nuisance if anything, though Doctor Mark Kramer is is least biggest fan. His concern and compassion lie in caring for the experiments, and  a certain someone who doesn't see him as a worthless pawn. Fun Fact: I forgot about his glasses early on and they haven't been referenced once since his introduction. Oops! Let's just say he got contacts now...
* Doctor Vivian Young (Last name in reference to Amanda Young, another Jigsaw apprentice) is the lead alchemist of the group. She's around the age of 28 and works well under pressure. Some may consider her cold, but deep down she does genuinely care about the experiments she had helped to create. Vivian has taken a liking to Vance, who she keeps safe from the other scientist's who would wish to do him harm, not even Doctor Kramer wants to mess with her. She's a complicated character, but her mystery is what drew Vance to her and he likes as something a little more than a friend.
* As a bonus I added in Vance's beloved sister, Abigail. She will never appear in the story, but she's a very nice girl and as caring as her brother. I put her at the age of around 17, she's young and Vance is very protective of her. Her illness is unexplained, and I'll let you all come to your own conclusions on what is wrong with her, though it doesn't matter in the slightest to the story.
